# Kyspec

Kyspec is a spec-driven method for AI coding agents: specs with the code,
changes deleted when done, git for the history, no CLI. It is the OpenSpec
spin-off we use at Kychee to build run402, our open-source backend for AI
agents, and our other products. Home: https://kyspec.com. Source:
https://github.com/kychee-com/kyspec (MIT). Five short skills, one method
(METHOD.md), one layout check (check-layout.mjs), no Kyspec workflow CLI.

## Install the kyspec.com skills

Four files, three lines, run from the repository root:

    git clone https://github.com/kychee-com/kyspec /tmp/kyspec
    cp /tmp/kyspec/METHOD.md /tmp/kyspec/check-layout.mjs .
    cp -r /tmp/kyspec/skills/kyspec-{brainstorm,plan,implement,verify,finish} .claude/skills/

1. METHOD.md goes to the repository root. It is the method the skills cite.
2. The five chain skills (kyspec-brainstorm, kyspec-plan, kyspec-implement,
   kyspec-verify, kyspec-finish) go into the coding agent's skills directory,
   each keeping its SKILL.md: .claude/skills/ for Claude Code,
   .agents/skills/ for Codex; another host uses its own skill location.
   A repository arriving from OpenSpec (it has an openspec/ directory) also
   takes skills/kyspec-migrate, for one run.
3. check-layout.mjs is the layout gate (dependency-free Node.js). Run
   `node check-layout.mjs` in CI; it checks the structure of changes and
   ideas, including the rule against archived or date-prefixed changes.
4. Add a `## Method declarations` section to AGENTS.md naming what the
   skills cannot know: the principles document, the release skills, the
   surface review, the coordination room. Omit a line that does not apply;
   METHOD.md "Method declarations" defines each. Example:

    ## Method declarations

    - **Principles:** docs/principles.md, numbered; specs cite principles #N.
    - **Release:** /deploy for the API and site; /publish for the npm package.
    - **Surface review:** /review-api for src/api/** and openapi.json; judge against docs/api-principles.md.
    - **Coordination room:** the channel and procedure for claiming an area and announcing completion.

Then start the work: invoke kyspec-brainstorm for an idea, or implement a
named issue with Kyspec. Verification of a changed user-facing flow runs in
a fresh thread with access to the released product.

## Migrate to Kyspec (from OpenSpec)

With the skills installed, including kyspec-migrate, run the kyspec-migrate
skill on a branch. It follows https://kyspec.com/MIGRATING.html (shipped
deltas merged by OpenSpec first, specs moved, living decisions lifted from
the archive as D-ids, active changes converted to the seven sections,
openspec/ deleted, skills and declarations installed, the gate run) and ends
by recording the migration as the repository's first change,
changes/adopt-kyspec.md.

  after): https://kyspec.com/examples/
